headline: Public hearings on Wendy's at 120 Broad Street, Stateline Wine & Spirits liquor renewal, and Mornin Sunshine Café.
summary: Renewals for four tattoo shops and 22 food businesses are on the consent agenda. Also on the agenda are a police activity report on Wendy's and a petition for a party with food and alcoholic beverages on December 26 at 120 High Street.
